ig_caption:
Still tied to someone you stopped talking to?
Checking their page is not weakness. It is your attention, still knotted to a person who left the room.
Pull it back for five minutes and feel how much road you have.
Comment CORD if you felt that tug, and send this to someone who needs it tonight.
